metadata.name: Smart Kitchen AI Recipe Database
metadata.description: Starter recipe catalogue. Every ingredient 'name' uses the canonical key from the Smart Kitchen AI Ingredient Database (not aliases), so recipes can be matched by exact string.
metadata.important_note: 'water' is treated as an implicit ingredient and is not listed in ingredients. Quantities are for the stated servings.

schema.meal_type: breakfast | lunch | dinner | snack | dessert | side | drink
schema.ingredients[].optional: true = recipe works without it; matcher should not require it
schema.ingredients[].unit: g | ml | tsp | tbsp | cup | piece | pinch | to taste

recipes.name: Jeera Aloo
steps: Boil potatoes until just tender, cool, peel and cube them.
Heat oil and splutter the cumin seeds.
Add turmeric, chilli powder and the potatoes; toss on medium heat for 5-7 minutes until lightly crisp.
Season with salt and garnish with coriander leaves.

recipes.name: Dal Tadka
steps: Pressure cook the washed dal with turmeric and salt until soft; mash lightly.
Heat ghee, add cumin seeds, garlic and green chilli.
Add chopped onion and cook until golden, then add tomatoes and chilli powder until soft.
Pour the tempering over the dal, simmer 5 minutes and garnish with coriander.

recipes.name: Moong Dal Khichdi
steps: Wash rice and dal together.
Heat ghee, add cumin, asafoetida and grated ginger.
Add rice, dal, turmeric, salt and about 4 cups water.
Pressure cook for 3-4 whistles until soft and porridge-like.

recipes.name: Chana Masala
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight and pressure cook until soft (or use canned).
Fry cumin, then onions until brown; add ginger and garlic.
Add tomatoes and ground spices; cook to a thick masala.
Add chickpeas and a cup of water, simmer 10-15 minutes, finish with garam masala and amchur.

recipes.name: Rajma Masala
steps: Soak kidney beans overnight, then pressure cook with salt until very soft.
Make a masala of cumin, onion, ginger-garlic, tomatoes and spices.
Add beans with their liquid, mash a few to thicken, simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with white rice.

recipes.name: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch spinach for 2 minutes, plunge in cold water and blend with green chilli.
Fry cumin, onion, ginger and garlic in ghee; add tomato and cook down.
Add spinach puree, salt and garam masala; simmer 5 minutes.
Add paneer cubes and cream; warm through.

recipes.name: Matar Paneer
steps: Blend onion and tomato into a smooth paste.
Cook ginger-garlic and the paste in oil with spices until oil separates.
Add peas and a little water; simmer 8 minutes.
Add paneer cubes, simmer 3 minutes and finish with garam masala.

recipes.name: Aloo Gobi
steps: Cut cauliflower into florets and potatoes into cubes.
Temper cumin in oil; fry onion and ginger, then tomato.
Add vegetables and spices, cover and cook on low until tender, stirring occasionally.

recipes.name: Bhindi Masala
steps: Wash okra, dry thoroughly and slice.
Fry okra in oil on medium heat until the stickiness goes; set aside.
Temper cumin, cook onion and tomato with spices, return okra and toss; finish with amchur.

recipes.name: Baingan Bharta
steps: Roast the whole eggplant over flame or in oven until charred and soft; peel and mash.
Temper cumin, cook garlic, chilli, onion and tomato with spices.
Add mashed eggplant and cook 8-10 minutes; garnish with coriander.

recipes.name: Lauki Sabzi
steps: Peel and cube the bottle gourd.
Temper cumin and green chilli, add tomato and spices.
Add lauki, cover and cook until tender, about 12-15 minutes.

recipes.name: Vegetable Pulao
steps: Soak basmati rice for 20 minutes.
Temper whole spices and cumin in oil; fry onion until golden.
Add chopped vegetables, rice, salt and 3 cups water.
Cook covered until water is absorbed; rest 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Jeera Rice
steps: Wash and soak rice 15 minutes.
Heat ghee, crackle cumin, add rice and sauté 1 minute.
Add 2 cups water and salt; cook covered until fluffy.

recipes.name: Kanda Poha
steps: Rinse poha in a colander until soft; drain well.
Fry peanuts, then mustard seeds, curry leaves and chilli.
Add onion (and diced potato) and cook until soft; add turmeric.
Fold in poha, salt and sugar, heat 2 minutes; finish with lemon juice and coriander.

recipes.name: Rava Upma
steps: Dry roast semolina until fragrant; set aside.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, chilli, ginger; cook onion and vegetables.
Add 2.5 cups boiling water and salt, then stream in semolina while stirring.
Cover and cook 3 minutes on low.

recipes.name: Besan Chilla
steps: Whisk gram flour with water into a smooth, pourable batter; add spices and salt.
Fold in chopped onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Pour onto a hot greased pan, spread thin and cook both sides until golden.

recipes.name: Aloo Paratha
steps: Knead flour, salt and water into a soft dough; rest 15 minutes.
Mash boiled potatoes with chilli, coriander, spices and salt.
Stuff dough balls with filling, roll out gently.
Cook on a hot tawa with ghee until golden on both sides.

recipes.name: Masala Omelette
steps: Beat eggs with chopped onion, tomato, chilli, coriander, pepper and salt.
Melt butter in a pan, pour in the mixture and cook until set.
Fold and serve hot with bread.

recipes.name: Egg Curry
steps: Hard boil eggs, peel and lightly score them.
Cook onion, ginger-garlic and tomato with spices into a thick masala.
Add water for gravy, drop in eggs and simmer 8 minutes; finish with garam masala.

recipes.name: Home-style Chicken Curry
steps: Marinate chicken with curd, turmeric and salt for 20 minutes.
Brown onions in oil; add ginger-garlic, then tomato and spices.
Add chicken, cook covered on low for 25-30 minutes until tender.
Finish with garam masala.

recipes.name: Mutton Curry
steps: Marinate mutton with curd, ginger-garlic and salt for at least 1 hour.
Heat mustard oil, add bay leaf and cloves, brown the onions deeply.
Add mutton and spices, sear 10 minutes, add tomato.
Pressure cook 6-8 whistles until tender; finish with garam masala.

recipes.name: Simple Fish Curry
steps: Rub fish with turmeric and salt; lightly fry and set aside.
Cook onion, ginger-garlic and tomato with spices into a masala.
Add water, bring to a simmer and slide in the fish; cook 8 minutes without stirring hard.

recipes.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Use cooked, cooled rice so grains stay separate.
Stir-fry garlic and chopped vegetables on high heat for 2-3 minutes.
Add rice, soy sauce, pepper and salt; toss 2 minutes and top with spring onion greens.

recipes.name: Veg Hakka Noodles
steps: Boil noodles al dente, drain, rinse and toss with a little oil.
Stir-fry garlic and julienned vegetables on high heat.
Add noodles, sauces, vinegar and salt; toss well.

recipes.name: Veg Manchurian (Dry)
steps: Grate cabbage and carrot, squeeze out moisture, mix with cornflour, flour and salt; shape into balls.
Deep fry until golden and drain.
Sauté ginger, garlic and spring onion; add soy, chilli sauce and ketchup.
Toss in the balls to coat.

recipes.name: Paneer Bhurji
steps: Crumble the paneer.
Melt butter, crackle cumin, cook onion, chilli and tomato with spices.
Add paneer, toss 3-4 minutes and finish with garam masala.

recipes.name: Grilled Veg Cheese Sandwich
steps: Butter the bread slices.
Layer sliced vegetables, pepper and salt, top with grated cheese.
Close and grill or toast until golden and the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Tomato Basil Pasta
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente; reserve a cup of pasta water.
Sauté garlic in olive oil, add chopped tomatoes and cook into a sauce.
Toss pasta in the sauce with a splash of pasta water, then add basil. Top with parmesan if using.

recipes.name: Masala Chai
steps: Boil 1 cup water with crushed ginger and cardamom for 2 minutes.
Add 1 tsp tea leaves (not in the ingredient catalogue), then the milk and sugar.
Simmer 3-4 minutes, strain and serve.

recipes.name: Sooji Halwa
steps: Roast semolina in ghee on low heat until fragrant and golden.
Add 1.5 cups hot water carefully along with sugar and cardamom.
Stir until thick and ghee separates; garnish with almonds and raisins.

recipes.name: Banana Oat Pancakes
steps: Blend bananas, oats and egg into a thick batter.
Cook small rounds on a buttered pan until bubbles form, flip and cook 1-2 minutes.
Serve with honey.

recipes.name: Fresh Veg Rice Paper Rolls
steps: Cook rice noodles, drain and cool; julienne the carrot and cucumber.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice and a little water into a dipping sauce.
Dip each rice paper in warm water for a few seconds, fill with noodles, vegetables and herbs, fold in the sides and roll tightly.

recipes.name: Crispy Fried Rice Paper Rolls
steps: Stir-fry garlic, shredded vegetables and mushrooms with soy sauce and pepper; cool completely.
Soften a rice paper sheet, add filling and roll tightly.
Shallow fry in hot oil until golden and crisp, turning once.

recipes.name: Gochujang Glazed Tofu
steps: Press tofu, cube it and pan-fry in oil until golden on all sides.
Mix gochujang, soy sauce, honey, minced garlic and sesame oil into a glaze.
Toss tofu in the glaze over low heat until sticky; top with sesame seeds and spring onion. Serve with white rice.

recipes.name: Gochujang Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken with gochujang, soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger and sesame oil for 30 minutes.
Sear chicken in oil until browned, add sliced onion.
Cover and cook on low 15 minutes until cooked through and sticky.

recipes.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
steps: Stir-fry chopped kimchi in oil for 3 minutes; stir in gochujang.
Add cooked, cooled rice and toss on high heat.
Top with fried eggs, spring onion, sesame oil and shredded nori.

recipes.name: Kimchi Tofu Stew
steps: Sauté kimchi, onion and garlic in sesame oil for 4 minutes.
Add gochujang and vegetable stock; simmer 10 minutes.
Add cubed tofu and mushrooms, simmer 5 minutes more; top with spring onion.

recipes.name: Miso Soup
steps: Bring 2 cups water to a gentle simmer and add cubed tofu and mushrooms for 3 minutes.
Turn off the heat; whisk miso with a ladle of hot broth, then stir it back in (do not boil).
Garnish with spring onion and torn nori.

recipes.name: Miso Glazed Eggplant
steps: Halve eggplants, score the flesh and brush with sesame oil; roast at 200C for 20 minutes.
Mix miso with honey and a splash of water, spread over the flesh.
Grill 3-4 minutes until bubbling; top with sesame seeds and spring onion.

recipes.name: Vegetable Sushi Rolls
steps: Cook rice and fold in vinegar, sugar and salt; cool to room temperature.
Spread rice over nori leaving a border; lay cucumber, carrot and avocado strips along one edge.
Roll tightly, slice with a wet knife and serve with soy sauce.

recipes.name: Pan-Fried Veg Dumplings
steps: Finely chop vegetables, squeeze out moisture and mix with ginger, garlic, soy sauce and sesame oil.
Fill and pleat the wrappers.
Fry bottoms in oil until golden, add a splash of water, cover and steam 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Veg Spring Rolls
steps: Stir-fry garlic and shredded vegetables on high heat with soy sauce and pepper; cool.
Roll filling into wrappers and seal edges with water.
Deep fry until golden and crisp.

recipes.name: Peanut Rice Noodle Stir-Fry
steps: Soak rice noodles in warm water until just flexible; drain.
Fry tofu until golden, add garlic, then noodles with soy sauce, tamarind paste and sugar.
Toss until glossy; top with crushed peanuts, spring onion and lime.

recipes.name: Idli with Sambar
steps: Steam idli batter in greased moulds for 12 minutes.
Pressure cook dal until mushy; simmer with chopped vegetables, tamarind paste, sambar powder and salt.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil, pour over the sambar and serve with idlis.

recipes.name: Masala Dosa
steps: Boil and roughly mash potatoes.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and chilli; cook onion, add turmeric, salt and potatoes for the filling.
Spread batter thin on a hot tawa, drizzle oil, cook until crisp, fill and fold. Serve with chutney.

recipes.name: Onion Tomato Uttapam
steps: Pour a thick round of batter on a hot tawa.
Scatter chopped onion, tomato, chilli and coriander and press in lightly.
Drizzle oil, cook covered until set and golden underneath, flip briefly. Serve with chutney.

recipes.name: Dhokla
steps: Gently fold baking soda into the batter and pour into a greased plate.
Steam 15 minutes until a skewer comes out clean; cool and cut into squares.
Temper mustard seeds, chilli, curry leaves and sesame seeds in oil with a splash of sugar water; pour over and garnish.

recipes.name: Sabudana Khichdi
steps: Soak sabudana for 4-6 hours until pearls are soft; drain well.
Fry cumin, chilli, cubed potato and crushed roasted peanuts.
Add sabudana, salt and sugar; cook on low until translucent and finish with lemon juice.

recipes.name: Masala Roasted Makhana
steps: Roast makhana in ghee on low heat, stirring, until crisp (about 8 minutes).
Toss with pepper, chaat masala and salt while warm.

recipes.name: Sattu Sharbat
steps: Whisk sattu into 2 cups cold water until lump-free.
Stir in lemon juice, black salt, cumin powder and mint; serve chilled.

recipes.name: Sattu Paratha
steps: Knead flour, salt and water into a soft dough.
Mix sattu with chopped onion, chilli, carom seeds, lemon juice, mustard oil and salt for the stuffing.
Stuff, roll and cook on a tawa with oil until golden.

recipes.name: Masala Papad
steps: Roast or fry the papad until crisp.
Top with chopped onion, tomato, chilli, chaat masala, lemon juice, sev and coriander. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Boondi Raita
steps: Whisk curd smooth with salt, black salt and cumin powder.
Soak boondi in water for 2 minutes, squeeze lightly and fold in; dust with chilli powder.

recipes.name: Sev Puri
steps: Arrange crackers on a plate and top each with boiled diced potato, onion and tomato.
Drizzle both chutneys, sprinkle chaat masala and load with sev and coriander.

recipes.name: Tomato Rasam
steps: Cook dal until soft and whisk with 2 cups water.
Simmer crushed tomatoes with tamarind paste, rasam powder, garlic and salt for 8 minutes; add the dal water.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and asafoetida in oil and pour over.

recipes.name: Sarson ka Saag with Makki Roti
steps: Cook chopped mustard greens, spinach, ginger, garlic and chilli with a little water until very soft; mash coarsely.
Sauté onion in ghee, add the greens and simmer 10 minutes; finish with white butter.
Knead cornmeal with warm water and salt, pat into flat rotis and cook on a tawa. Serve together.

recipes.name: Methi Thepla
steps: Mix flours, chopped fenugreek leaves, curd, spices, sesame seeds, salt and 1 tbsp oil.
Knead to a soft dough with water and rest 15 minutes.
Roll thin and cook on a tawa with a little oil until spotted.

recipes.name: Karela Fry
steps: Slice karela thin, rub with salt and rest 15 minutes; squeeze out the bitter juice.
Fry onions until golden, add karela and cook on medium-low until crisp.
Add spices and amchur, toss 2 minutes.

recipes.name: Khatta Meetha Kaddu
steps: Heat mustard oil and crackle fenugreek and fennel seeds.
Add cubed pumpkin, chilli powder and salt; cook covered until soft.
Stir in jaggery and amchur and mash lightly.

recipes.name: Dal Makhani
steps: Soak black gram and kidney beans overnight; pressure cook until very soft.
Cook ginger, garlic and tomato puree in butter with chilli powder until thick.
Add the dal, simmer 30 minutes mashing a few, then finish with cream and garam masala.

recipes.name: Masoor Dal Tadka
steps: Boil red lentils with turmeric and salt until soft, about 15 minutes.
Fry cumin, garlic, dried red chillies and onion in oil.
Pour the tadka over the dal.

recipes.name: Moong Sprouts Chaat
steps: Steam sprouts for 5 minutes if you prefer them softer, then cool.
Toss with chopped onion, tomato, cucumber, chilli, chaat masala and lemon juice.
Garnish with coriander.

recipes.name: Kala Chana Curry
steps: Soak kala chana overnight and pressure cook until tender.
Make a masala of onion, ginger-garlic, tomato and spices.
Add chana with its water and simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Lobia Masala
steps: Soak and pressure cook black-eyed peas until soft.
Cook onion, ginger-garlic, tomato and spices into a masala.
Add lobia and simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Ragi Dosa
steps: Whisk ragi, semolina, salt, cumin, chopped onion, chilli and curry leaves with water to a thin batter; rest 10 minutes.
Pour onto a hot tawa in a spiral, drizzle oil and cook until crisp.

recipes.name: Bajra Roti
steps: Knead flour with salt and warm water into a smooth dough.
Pat or roll into thick rotis.
Cook on a hot tawa, puff over flame and serve with ghee.

recipes.name: Jowar Roti with Bharwa Baingan
steps: Dry roast and coarsely grind peanuts and sesame; mix with spices and salt.
Slit baby eggplants, stuff with the masala and cook covered in oil until tender.
Knead sorghum flour with hot water, pat into rotis and cook on a tawa.

recipes.name: Homemade Hummus with Pita
steps: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt with a few spoons of cold water until silky.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve with warmed pita.

recipes.name: Baked Falafel
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight (do not cook), drain and pulse with onion, garlic, parsley and spices into a coarse mixture.
Mix in flour and baking powder; shape into patties.
Brush with olive oil and bake at 200C for 25 minutes, flipping halfway.

recipes.name: Pesto Pasta
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve a little pasta water.
Toss hot pasta with pesto and a splash of pasta water.
Finish with parmesan, toasted pine nuts and pepper.

recipes.name: Stovetop Mac and Cheese
steps: Boil macaroni until al dente and drain.
Melt butter, stir in flour for 1 minute, then whisk in milk until thick.
Melt in grated cheddar, mustard powder, pepper and salt; fold in the macaroni.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water; reserve a cup of pasta water.
Gently cook sliced garlic and chilli flakes in olive oil until fragrant, not brown.
Toss pasta in the oil with pasta water until glossy; finish with parsley.

recipes.name: Margherita Pizza
steps: Preheat oven to its highest setting and stretch the dough thin.
Spread tomato paste, scatter mozzarella and season.
Bake 10-12 minutes until the crust is blistered; top with basil and olive oil.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
steps: Soften onion, bell pepper and garlic in olive oil; add spices.
Add canned tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Make wells, crack in eggs, cover and cook until whites set; crumble feta over.

recipes.name: Black Bean Tacos
steps: Warm black beans with cumin, paprika, salt and a little oil; mash lightly.
Mix onion, tomato, jalapeno, coriander, lime juice and salt into a salsa; mash the avocado.
Warm tortillas and fill with beans, avocado and salsa.

recipes.name: Veg Cheese Quesadilla
steps: Sauté onion, capsicum and corn with paprika for 3 minutes.
Fill half of each tortilla with cheese and the vegetables; fold over.
Toast in butter until golden and the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Quinoa Chickpea Salad
steps: Rinse quinoa and simmer in 1.5 cups water for 15 minutes; fluff and cool.
Toss with chickpeas, chopped vegetables and parsley.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil and salt.

recipes.name: Greek Salad
steps: Chop cucumber, tomato and red onion into chunks.
Top with feta, olive oil, oregano and salt; toss lightly.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast
steps: Toast the sourdough until crisp.
Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt, spread on toast and top with chilli flakes and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Mango Lassi
steps: Peel and chop mangoes.
Blend with curd, milk, sugar and cardamom until smooth; serve chilled.

recipes.name: Strawberry Banana Smoothie
steps: Blend strawberries, banana, yogurt, milk and honey until smooth.

recipes.name: Fruit Chaat
steps: Cube all the fruit and toss gently.
Sprinkle with chaat masala, black salt and lemon juice; serve at once.

recipes.name: Chia Overnight Oats
steps: Mix oats, chia seeds, oat milk and maple syrup in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight and top with blueberries and almonds.

recipes.name: Masala Oats
steps: Temper cumin in oil, cook onion, carrot and tomato with turmeric.
Add oats, salt and 1.5 cups water; cook 4-5 minutes until creamy.

recipes.name: Gajar ka Halwa
steps: Grate carrots and cook in ghee for 5 minutes.
Add milk and simmer, stirring, until almost dry.
Stir in sugar and cardamom, cook until thick; garnish with fried cashews and raisins.

recipes.name: Rice Kheer
steps: Wash and soak rice for 20 minutes.
Simmer rice in milk on low heat, stirring often, until thick and creamy (about 35 minutes).
Add sugar, cardamom and saffron; garnish with pistachios.

recipes.name: Seviyan Kheer
steps: Roast broken vermicelli in ghee until golden.
Add hot milk and simmer 10 minutes until soft.
Stir in sugar, cardamom, raisins and almonds.

recipes.name: Chocolate Mug Cake
steps: Whisk everything except chips in a large mug until smooth; fold in chocolate chips.
Microwave on high for 90 seconds to 2 minutes until risen and set.

recipes.name: Dark Chocolate Brownies
steps: Melt chocolate with butter and cool slightly; whisk in sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Fold in flour, cocoa, salt and walnuts.
Bake in a lined tin at 175C for 22-25 minutes; cool before slicing.

recipes.name: Banana Bread
steps: Mash ripe bananas and mix with sugar and oil.
Fold in flour, baking soda, cinnamon, salt and walnuts.
Bake in a loaf tin at 175C for 45-50 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.name: Creamy Tomato Soup
steps: Sauté onion, garlic and carrot in butter; add chopped tomatoes and 2 cups water.
Simmer 15 minutes and blend smooth; strain if desired.
Season with salt, pepper and sugar; finish with cream.

recipes.name: Cream of Mushroom Soup
steps: Sauté onion, garlic and chopped mushrooms in butter until browned.
Stir in flour, then milk and thyme; simmer 10 minutes.
Blend partly for a rustic texture; season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Roasted Pumpkin Soup
steps: Roast cubed pumpkin with olive oil at 200C for 20 minutes.
Soften onion and garlic, add pumpkin and stock, simmer 10 minutes.
Blend smooth, season with salt and nutmeg and top with toasted seeds.

recipes.name: Chicken Biryani
steps: Marinate chicken with curd, ginger-garlic, biryani masala, mint and salt for 1 hour; brown the onions for topping.
Parboil soaked basmati rice to 70% done.
Layer chicken, rice, fried onions, saffron milk and ghee; seal and cook on dum (low heat) for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Vegetable Biryani
steps: Marinate vegetables with curd, ginger-garlic, biryani masala and salt; brown the onions.
Parboil soaked rice with whole salt to 70% done.
Layer vegetables, rice, onions, mint and ghee; cook sealed on low heat for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka
steps: Marinate cubed chicken with curd, tandoori masala, ginger-garlic, lemon juice, oil and salt for at least 2 hours.
Skewer and grill or bake at 220C for 15-20 minutes, turning once.
Serve with sliced onion and lemon.

recipes.name: Paneer Tikka
steps: Toss paneer, capsicum and onion chunks in the tikka marinade for 30 minutes.
Skewer and grill or pan-sear in oil until charred at the edges.
Sprinkle with chaat masala.

recipes.name: Butter Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, ginger-garlic, chilli powder and salt; sear until lightly charred.
Simmer tomato puree in butter with garam masala for 12 minutes.
Add chicken and cream, simmer 10 minutes and finish with crushed kasuri methi.

recipes.name: Prawn Masala
steps: Marinate cleaned prawns with turmeric and salt for 10 minutes.
Cook onion, ginger-garlic, curry leaves and tomato with spices in coconut oil.
Add prawns and cook 5-6 minutes only, until pink and curled.

recipes.name: Kerala-style Fish Curry
steps: Sauté onion, ginger, garlic, chilli and curry leaves in coconut oil; add turmeric and chilli powder.
Add kokum and a cup of water; simmer 5 minutes.
Add fish and coconut milk and cook gently for 8-10 minutes.

recipes.name: Pan-Seared Lemon Pepper Salmon
steps: Season salmon with salt and pepper.
Sear skin-side down in butter for 4 minutes, flip, add garlic and cook 3 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice and dill.

recipes.name: Tuna Salad Sandwich
steps: Flake tuna and mix with mayonnaise, chopped onion, celery and pepper.
Spread on bread with lettuce and close the sandwiches.

recipes.name: Mutton Keema Matar
steps: Brown onions in oil; add ginger-garlic and tomato with spices.
Add minced lamb and cook 15 minutes until dry and fragrant.
Add peas and a little water, cook 8 minutes and finish with garam masala.

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble eggs in oil and set aside.
Stir-fry carrot and peas on high heat, add cold cooked rice and soy sauce.
Fold in eggs, pepper and spring onion; finish with sesame oil.

recipes.name: Thai Coconut Vegetable Curry
steps: Fry curry paste and bruised lemongrass in oil for 1 minute.
Add coconut milk, soy sauce and sugar; simmer 5 minutes.
Add vegetables and cook 8-10 minutes until tender; finish with lime. Serve with jasmine or white rice.

recipes.name: Bok Choy and Shiitake Stir-Fry
steps: Sear sliced shiitake in oil until browned.
Add garlic, ginger and bok choy; stir-fry 2-3 minutes on high heat.
Finish with soy sauce and sesame oil.
